title: Fresh Coat Painters of Gainesville Alternative
description: Comparing Fresh Coat Painters of Gainesville with Precision Paint Experts? How to handle color choices, drawdowns, and matching before a Gainesville repaint.
h1: Fresh Coat Painters of Gainesville vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Color is the part of a repaint you live with every day. This guide helps Gainesville homeowners compare how bidders handle color selection and matching.

keywords.primary: fresh coat painters of gainesville vs precision paint experts
questions: How do I choose a paint color I will not regret?
Can a painter match an existing paint color?

body: Fresh Coat Painters of Gainesville is one of the painting and property-service companies Gainesville homeowners may be comparing. Most people collecting bids already have a rough color idea, and most of them have also stared at a tiny chip and wondered how it will look across an entire wall. How a contractor helps you get from chip to confident decision is a fair thing to compare.
This guide covers the color questions to ask every bidder and what Precision Paint Experts offers, without commenting on any other company's process.

A two-inch chip under store lighting looks very different on a north-facing living room wall or a sunny west elevation. Large areas read lighter and more saturated than the chip suggests, and Gainesville's tree canopy can cast a green tint onto exterior walls in the shade. That is why we use full-size drawdowns, large painted samples you can hold up in your own light at different times of day before anything is committed to the walls.

Sheen plays a role as well. The same color in flat and in semi-gloss will look like two different shades side by side, because glossier finishes reflect more light. When you compare bids, make sure each one lists the sheen as well as the color name, so you are not surprised when the trim and walls go up.

sections.h2: Color questions to ask any contractor
bullets: Will I see a large sample before the color is final?
Can you match an existing color from a chip, a door, or an old can?
How many colors are included in the price?
Will you note the exact color formula on the estimate or invoice?
Is touch-up paint left behind, and is it labelled?

sections.h2: How we handle color and matching
body: Precision Paint Experts can match color from a chip, a cabinet door, or a leftover can, which helps when you are refreshing part of a home and want the rest to stay consistent. Our Gainesville color consultation service is there if you want help narrowing choices, and our color consultation page explains how we work through options with you.

The number of colors affects the price, so it is listed on the estimate along with products and coat counts. At the end of the job, labelled touch-up paint is left with you so future small repairs match.

If you live in an older neighborhood or simply like period-appropriate palettes, our post on historic paint colors in Gainesville is a good starting point. For interiors, see our guide to Florida interior paint colors. Once you have a short list, request a walkthrough. It is usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the itemized estimate follows within about one business day.

Bring your drawdowns or chips to the walkthrough if you have them. The crew lead can look at them in place, flag any surfaces where coverage may need a third coat, and reflect that on the written quote.

faqs.q: Can you match a color if I only have an old paint can?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match from a leftover can, a chip, or an existing surface such as a cabinet door, and show you a full-size drawdown first.

faqs.q: Does the number of colors change the price?
faqs.a: It can. The number of colors is one of the factors that affects price, and it is listed on your estimate.

faqs.q: Is Precision Paint Experts affiliated with Fresh Coat Painters of Gainesville?
faqs.a: No. We are an independent, locally owned company based in Newberry, FL.
